other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (close opposite side before entry)

custom_logic_notes: EA uses CCI line crossing its own MA (signal line) as the sole signal mechanism. When an opposite signal occurs, the existing position is closed first then a new position is opened in the opposite direction. SL/TP values are digit-adjusted (multiplied by 10) for 5-digit brokers. Previous bar values ([1]) are used for crossover detection to confirm the cross has occurred.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. CCI and its SMA can be computed using pandas_ta or ta-lib. The crossover logic compares CCI[1] vs MA[1] and CCI[2] vs MA[2] to detect crosses on the previous completed bar. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit) should be handled in the order placement function. New bar detection via bar timestamp comparison is needed to limit signals to once per bar.
